reasoning: The question asks whether the 4-week T-bill rate will increase from March 15 to March 22, 2026. Evidence shows short-term Treasury yields have been relatively stable with slight upward movements in early 2026, hovering around 3.5-3.6%. The Fed meeting on March 17-18 could influence rates, though the Fed has been holding rates steady. Week-to-week changes in short-term rates are somewhat random, with historical data showing roughly equal probability of increases vs decreases. Given the upcoming FOMC meeting and recent slight upward trend in short-term yields, I estimate a slightly above 50% chance of an increase.
